recap.intro: What a fantastic week of learning we've had exploring two crucial areas of B2B marketing: navigating the world of paid advertising and building stronger, more targeted customer relationships.
bullets: The cost for businesses to advertise on Google using specific keywords has gone up significantly, with some seeing a 21% increase.
Many companies value AI skills but a large majority of workers say their AI abilities have never been officially tested.
Business leaders trust advice from real people more than AI-generated information when making high-stakes decisions.
Using plain, simple language is essential for companies to create a good customer experience and build loyalty.
recap.closing: This week you learned that while the B2B marketing landscape evolves with technology and costs, the human element of trust and clear communication remains paramount.
